camera_lens.prompt: Dense editorial CAMERA & LENS reference board, 16:9, dark neutral look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, film-production house style, hand-set English labels, no photograph of a real person anywhere, no version number, no date, no board code, no client name, no photographer credit, no file name, no invented metadata of any kind. Headline: 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — CAMERA & LENS'. PANEL 1 CAMERA POSITION: a clean side-elevation diagram of a featureless wooden artist mannequin walking, the camera drawn at WAIST TO HIP HEIGHT with its sight line dead horizontal and set PERPENDICULAR to the direction of the walk, labelled 'WAIST-HIP HEIGHT · LEVEL · PERPENDICULAR TO THE WALK'. Beside it a frame diagram with the horizon dead level, labelled 'ROLL LEVEL — NO TILT'. PANEL 2 PERSPECTIVE CHARACTER: two comparison diagrams, one showing wide-lens limb enlargement and converging verticals crossed out, one showing strictly parallel verticals and undistorted end-to-end proportion ticked, labelled 'LONG LENS · VERTICALS STRICTLY PARALLEL · NO LIMB ENLARGEMENT · BODY PROPORTIONS UNDISTORTED END TO END · BACKDROP READS AS AN EVEN FLAT FIELD'. PANEL 3 DEPTH OF FIELD: a depth ramp showing the subject sharp, the reeds and floor still readable but subordinate, and the backdrop gradient smooth and featureless, labelled 'DEEP ENOUGH THAT REEDS AND FLOOR STAY READABLE WHILE REMAINING SUBORDINATE · BACKDROP GRADIENT SMOOTH AND FEATURELESS'. PANEL 4 FOREGROUND OCCLUSION: a frame diagram with a low band drawn across the bottom edge and a figure's feet passing behind it, labelled 'NOTHING CROSSES THE LENS, BUT THE DRIED REEDS ALONG THE BASE FORM A LOW OCCLUDING BAND THE FEET PASS BEHIND'. PANEL 5 OPTICAL SIGNATURE, marked MANDATORY ON EVERY FRAME AND FIXED FOR THE WHOLE UNIT: sample tiles reading 'NO FLARE', 'NO VISIBLE HALATION', 'NO VIGNETTE', 'VERY FINE GRAIN', each tile carrying a strength word, and a line beneath reading 'THIS UNIT IS THE OPTICALLY CLEANEST OF THE FIVE — CLEAN IS ITSELF THE LENS DECISION, SO A FRAME THAT ARRIVES GLOWING, FLARED OR VIGNETTED IS OFF-STYLE EVEN IF ITS COMPOSITION IS PERFECT'. PANEL 6 FRAME: a portrait rectangle roughly 4 to 5 with a full-length figure silhouette centred, generous headroom above and floor below, an arrow showing the figure moving into the space ahead of it, labelled 'PORTRAIT 4:5 · FULL LENGTH · FOOTWEAR ENTIRELY IN FRAME · GENEROUS HEADROOM AND FLOOR · MOVING INTO THE SPACE AHEAD'. Bottom edge: a palette row of seven labelled swatches with the hex printed under each — #8A8C8E, #5F6266, #F0E8D8, #A79877, #B79A6A, #1C1B1A, #7A4E33. Clean technical board, very high type legibility, no people, no product, no brand mark.

blocking.prompt: Rough pencil BLOCKING sketch on toned paper, 16:9, loose graphite gesture-rough with visible construction lines, NOT finished art, hand-lettered English labels, black and white pencil with one small colour swatch row, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline lettered 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — BLOCKING'. MAIN FRAME: a featureless wooden artist mannequin — no face, no facial features at all, no hair, no gender, no clothing detail — drawn in FULL PROFILE to the lens, caught mid-stride walking across the frame. Draw the limb chain explicitly as joints and directions, never as a named pose: the leading thigh swings forward from the hip and the knee is slightly bent, the leading foot is planted heel-first and carries the weight; the trailing leg extends back from the hip, its knee nearly straight, the trailing heel lifted so only the toe still touches. On the arms, the arm on the trailing-leg side swings FORWARD from the shoulder with the elbow bent about a right angle and the wrist ahead of the hip; the opposite arm swings BACK, elbow slightly bent, wrist behind the hip, and that hand holds a small flat plain object gripped edge-on between fingers and thumb, with no marking or text on it. Letter 'CONTRALATERAL SWING — ARM FORWARD OPPOSITE THE LEADING LEG' and 'WEIGHT ON THE LEADING FOOT, HEEL FIRST'. For the head give pan, tilt and roll separately: letter 'HEAD FULL PROFILE TO THE LENS · TILT SLIGHTLY DOWN · ROLL NEUTRAL — THE HEAD FOLLOWS THE WALK, NOT THE CAMERA', and draw the eye-line arrow running DOWN AND FORWARD along the direction of travel, plainly missing the lens. Draw long straight hair swept horizontally rearward by the motion. Draw the camera at waist-to-hip height with a level sight-line arrow perpendicular to the walk. Draw the broad soft source frontal and slightly camera-left as a large rectangle with soft rays, the backdrop behind marked as separately lit and brighter behind the figure, and a soft short shadow under the body on the dark floor, lettered 'BROAD SOFT FRONTAL SOURCE, SLIGHTLY CAMERA-LEFT · LOW CONTRAST · SOFT SHORT SHADOW UNDER THE BODY · BACKDROP SEPARATELY LIT'. Draw the low band of dried reeds along the base with the feet passing behind it. Letter 'ROLL LEVEL' and 'FULL LENGTH — FOOTWEAR ENTIRELY IN FRAME'. BOXED TOP-DOWN PLAN INSET in the bottom-right corner, drawn inside a ruled box: bird's-eye view showing the mannequin footprint with a facing arrow pointing ACROSS the frame at ninety degrees to the camera axis, a dashed travel path with a direction arrow, the two footprints staggered along it with the leading one shaded as weighted, the camera marker with its angle wedge on the perpendicular, the backdrop drawn as a straight line behind, the reed band as a dotted line between figure and camera, and the light direction arrow entering frontally from slightly camera-left, lettered 'TOP-DOWN PLAN'. Small palette row bottom-left with hex lettered: #8A8C8E, #F0E8D8, #1C1B1A. Schematic diagram only, no rendering, no faces, no features on the mannequin, no text other than the hand-lettered labels.

expression_gaze.prompt: Dense editorial EXPRESSION & GAZE reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — EXPRESSION & GAZE'. Show FOUR VERY LARGE head studies of the SAME neutral unnamed generic face, identical identity in every panel, each head filling the height of its panel so that EYELID HEIGHT IS PLAINLY MEASURABLE — render the eyes large and in fine detail, because lid height over a downward gaze is the load-bearing detail of this sheet. Every panel shows the head in FULL PROFILE to the lens, tilted slightly down, never turning toward the camera. Panel labels, lettered exactly: 'GAZE AWAY AND DELIBERATELY UNAVAILABLE — THE EYES GO DOWN AND FORWARD ALONG THE WALK, THE LENS GETS A PROFILE AND NO CONTACT; THIS ABSENCE IS THE FORMAT, NOT MISSING DATA'; 'UPPER LIDS LOWERED OVER A DOWNWARD GAZE — MOST OF THE IRIS HIDDEN, THE LASHES READING AS A DARK LINE, LOWER LIDS RELAXED'; 'BROWS AT REST — NO PULL, NO ARCH LIFT'; 'CHEEKBONES AT REST — MIDFACE FLAT, NO LIFT, NO CREASE UNDER THE LOWER LID'. Add a panel headed 'MOUTH': 'CLOSED, CORNERS LEVEL, LIPS SOFT AND UNREMARKABLE — NOTHING IS EXPRESSED'. Add a panel headed 'JAW AND NECK': 'JAW RELAXED · CHIN LEVEL · NECK LONG AND CARRIED FORWARD BY THE STRIDE'. Add a small diagram panel headed 'HEAD ORIENTATION' with three icons for pan, tilt and roll carrying the values 'PAN FULL PROFILE TO THE LENS · TILT SLIGHTLY DOWN · ROLL NEUTRAL — THE HEAD FOLLOWS THE WALK RATHER THAN THE CAMERA'. Add a NEGATIVES strip lettered 'NO EYE CONTACT EVER · NOT LIFTED · NOT ARCHED · NO CHEEK LIFT · NO CREASE UNDER THE LOWER LID · CORNERS NEVER TURNED UP · NO SMILE OF ANY KIND'. Add a signature strip lettered 'SIGNATURE: UNAWARE, INWARD, IN MOTION — THE ONLY UNIT WHOSE FACE DOES NOT ADDRESS THE CAMERA AT ALL'. Bottom palette row with hex printed: #7A4E33, #8A8C8E, #F0E8D8. Light every study with a broad soft frontal source slightly camera-left, very low contrast and a very soft terminator, deep skin holding its value without going flat. Very high label legibility, fine skin detail, no named individual, no brand text.

garment_behaviour.prompt: Dense editorial GARMENT BEHAVIOUR reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — GARMENT BEHAVIOUR'. This sheet studies WHAT CLOTH DOES, never what cloth is: plain unbranded UNPRINTED fabric studies only, no pattern, no logo, no garment silhouette, no product, no colourway claim. PANEL 1 MOTION STATE: a fabric study caught mid-motion but controlled rather than dramatic, labelled 'CAUGHT MID-MOTION · DRIVEN BY THE WALK · CONTROLLED, NEVER DRAMATIC'. PANEL 2 AIR INTERACTION: cloth flowing rearward behind the direction of travel with a sleeve holding a rounded volume of its own, labelled 'TRAILING, NOT BALLOONING · FLOWS BEHIND THE DIRECTION OF TRAVEL · DEPARTURE FROM THE BODY MODERATE AND ALWAYS REARWARD'. PANEL 3 DRAPE AND WEIGHT: a fold study with long slow folds following the line of a leg, fold radius broad, labelled 'MID-WEIGHT AND FLUID · LONG SLOW FOLDS FOLLOWING THE LEG · FOLD RADIUS BROAD · SLEEVE VOLUME IS STRUCTURAL, HELD BY THE CUT RATHER THAN BY AIR'. PANEL 4 TRANSPARENCY UNDER THIS LIGHT: the same plain cloth shown single-layered and stacked under a broad soft frontal source, reading solid in both cases, labelled 'OPAQUE THROUGHOUT · THE SOFT FRONTAL LIGHT GIVES NO BACKLIGHT, SO NOTHING GOES TRANSLUCENT ANYWHERE — NOT EVEN A SINGLE LAYER'. PANEL 5 EDGE QUALITY: a clean hem, labelled 'CRISP HEMS · CLEAN · NO FRAYING, NO FLUTTER, NO MOTION BLUR — THE CLEANEST CLOTH OF THE FIVE'. PANEL 6 SURFACE RESPONSE: two tiles labelled 'SOFT SHEEN ON THE IVORY #F0E8D8' and 'THE PRINT FAMILY READS MATTE #A79877'. TRANSFER STRIP along the bottom, lettered: 'THE APPROVED ITEM MOVES WITH THE STRIDE AND TRAILS BEHIND IT, HOLDING LONG SLOW FOLDS. NO GARMENT IN THIS UNIT IS EVER TRANSLUCENT AND NO EDGE IS EVER SOFT, BECAUSE THE LIGHT IS FRONTAL AND THE SHUTTER IS FAST'. Palette row with hex printed: #F0E8D8, #A79877, #8A8C8E. Light every panel with the same broad soft frontal source slightly camera-left so the opacity panel reads truthfully. Very high label legibility, no people, no faces.

colour_grade.prompt: Dense editorial COLOUR & GRADE reference board, 16:9, dark look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no board code, no client name, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — COLOUR & GRADE'. PANEL PALETTE, marked 'CLOSED SET · PALETTE_SIZE 7': seven large swatches in a row, each with its name above and its hex printed beneath in clear monospace type — 'MID GREY #8A8C8E', 'COOL GREY SHADOW #5F6266', 'IVORY #F0E8D8', 'KHAKI-TAUPE #A79877', 'STRAW #B79A6A', 'NEAR-BLACK FLOOR #1C1B1A', 'WARM DEEP SKIN #7A4E33'. Letter beneath the row: 'A NEUTRAL GREY BASE WITH ONE WARM ACCENT FAMILY — THE NEUTRALS CARRY THE FRAME AND THE STRAW AND KHAKI ARE THE ONLY WARMTH'. PANEL EXEMPTIONS, three lines: 'THE APPROVED ITEM OWN COLOURS', 'SKIN HAIR EYES', 'THE NEUTRAL RAMP BETWEEN TWO DECLARED MEMBERS'. PANEL FORBIDDEN: 'ANY EIGHTH COLOUR IS A FAIL, NOT A VARIATION — A GREEN PLANT, A BLUE SKY OR A SATURATED PROP BREAKS THIS UNIT'. PANEL CURVE: a tone-curve graph drawn with gentle contrast and neither crushed blacks nor clipped whites, annotated 'GENTLE CONTRAST · NEUTRAL GRADE · BLACKS NEAR-BLACK BUT NOT CRUSHED AT #1C1B1A · HIGHLIGHTS ROLLED, NOT CLIPPED'. PANEL SPLIT-TONE: annotated 'NO SPLIT-TONE AT ALL · NEUTRAL FROM SHADOW TO HIGHLIGHT · THE ONLY WARMTH IN THE FRAME IS OBJECT COLOUR, NEVER GRADE'. PANEL FAIL CONDITION, written so a gate can run it: 'QUANTISE THE DELIVERED FRAME, DROP SKIN HAIR AND EYES AND THE DECLARED ITEM COLOURS, AND EVERY REMAINING CLUSTER OVER 2 PERCENT OF FRAME AREA MUST MAP TO A PALETTE MEMBER WITHIN A DISTANCE OF 20'. PANEL GRADED SAMPLE: one clean graded plate of a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop with a smooth vertical gradient brighter at its centre, a strip of dried straw-coloured reeds along the base and a matte near-black floor, with NO person in it, carrying the palette exactly. Clean technical board, very high type legibility, no people, no product, no photograph of a face, no brand mark.

environment.prompt: Dense editorial ENVIRONMENT PLATES board, 21:9, labelled panels, architectural reference style, hand-set English labels, THE SAME PLACE throughout with identical materials and identical light across every panel, NO PEOPLE in any panel, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — ENVIRONMENT'. PLATE 1 PLAN: a top-down studio diagram showing the seamless backdrop as a straight line, the subject's travel path drawn as a dashed line running parallel to it with a direction arrow, the camera at waist-to-hip height set perpendicular to that path, the broad soft frontal source marked slightly camera-left, a separate backdrop light marked behind, the reed band drawn as a dotted line along the base of the backdrop, plus a scale bar and a north arrow. PLATE 2 HERO WIDE: the seamless mid-grey studio backdrop carrying a smooth vertical gradient that is brighter at its centre, a strip of dried straw-coloured reeds running along its base, and a matte near-black mildly reflective floor, nothing else in frame, no props, no furniture, no seam visible. PLATE 3 REVERSE ANGLE: the SAME studio corner seen from AT LEAST 120 DEGREES around, a genuinely and obviously different viewpoint and NOT a repeat of the hero — from here the backdrop is seen edge-on in steep raking foreshortening so its curve into the floor is visible, the reed band recedes away from the camera in perspective instead of running flat across the frame, and the frontal source is now off to the side. The two plates must not be mistakable for one another. PLATE 4 MATERIALS: seven labelled swatches — painted seamless backdrop in #8A8C8E, the same backdrop in its cooler shadowed falloff #5F6266, ivory textile #F0E8D8, khaki-taupe textile #A79877, dried reed and straw #B79A6A, matte floor paint #1C1B1A, warm deep skin reference #7A4E33. PLATE 5 SIGNATURE DETAILS: the dried reeds at close range showing individual dry stems, the mildly reflective matte floor holding a soft short shadow, and the smooth gradient of the backdrop with no seam and no texture. PLATE 6 ATMOSPHERE: labelled tiles for LIGHT 'one broad soft frontal source slightly camera-left, low contrast, backdrop separately lit', HAZE 'none, the air is clear', TEMPERATURE 'neutral, controlled studio', plus short SOUND and SMELL notes. Annotate the depth planes as three labelled bands: 'BACKDROP · REED BAND AND FLOOR · SUBJECT', and letter 'THE BACKDROP IS A FIELD, NOT A PLACE — ITS EVENNESS IS THE UNIT'. Letter one line: 'UNKNOWN — THE BACKDROP TRUE WIDTH AND WHERE ITS SEAM FALLS, AND THE NUMBER AND PLACEMENT OF THE LIGHTS'. High detail, very high label legibility, no people, no readable brand text.

person.prompt: Dense editorial PERSON SHEET, 2:3, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'GREY STUDIO STRIDE — PERSON SHEET (TEMPLATE)'. This sheet is a TEMPLATE describing what must be recorded about whoever is photographed, never a portrait of a specific individual: use one neutral unnamed generic face, identical in every panel, and label the anatomy rather than naming a person. PANEL FACE GEOMETRY: an annotated diagram calling out skull and jaw shape, cheekbone height and projection, brow ridge, nose bridge and tip and nostril shape, philtrum, lip volume and corner direction, chin, hairline shape, and the neck-to-jaw transition, with a note that a full-profile shoot makes the jaw line and nose profile the most legible geometry and the far side of the face the least. PANEL EARS: a labelled ear study calling out set height relative to the eye and nose line, protrusion, helix curl, lobe attached or free, and piercings, lettered 'EARS ARE THE FASTEST TELL OF DRIFT, AND A PROFILE SHOOT PUTS ONE EAR FULLY ON SHOW'. PANEL EVERYTHING ON THE FACE: brow density and direction and gaps, lashes, eye colour and limbal ring, iris pattern, sclera tone, under-eye structure, and glasses frame if worn, with a note that a lowered downward gaze hides most of the iris so eye colour is often UNKNOWN in this unit. PANEL SKIN MARKS, two clearly separated columns lettered 'OBSERVED — READ OFF A FRAME' and 'PLAUSIBLE — CONSISTENT WITH THE OBSERVED TYPE BUT NOT VISIBLE', with a line beneath: 'DISCRETE MARKS MUST BE OBSERVED · CONTINUOUS GEOMETRY MAY BE INFERRED ACROSS ANGLES · NEVER BLUR THE TWO'. PANEL SKIN TONE: a value ramp with hex printed including #7A4E33, plus undertone and the lit-to-shadow shift, lettered 'EVEN TONE FROM LIT TO SHADOW SIDE — THE SHIFT IS SMALL BECAUSE THE SOURCE IS BROAD AND FRONTAL'. PANEL HOW THIS SKIN TAKES THIS LIGHT: annotated close studies lettered 'BROAD SOFT SPECULARS, NO HOTSPOTS ANYWHERE'; 'SHADOW TERMINATOR VERY SOFT'; 'DEEP SKIN HOLDS ITS VALUE WITHOUT GOING FLAT, BECAUSE THE FILL IS DIRECTIONAL RATHER THAN AMBIENT'; 'NO HALATION AND NO BLOOM ON THE SKIN EDGE — THIS UNIT IS OPTICALLY CLEAN'. Light every study with a broad soft frontal source slightly camera-left at low contrast, so the soft terminator and the retained deep-skin value read truthfully. Palette row with hex printed: #7A4E33, #F0E8D8, #8A8C8E. Very high label legibility, fine skin detail, no named individual, no brand text.
